name: Blackwater Apocalypse Kit
description: Original source-authored architecture for The Last Dead. This local inspection catalog uses the Vibe3D createModel workflow; it is not an installed upstream registry or CLI package.

contract.materialOwnership: Supplied materials are borrowed. Unique house siding and shop signs are model-owned. Call the model dispose method for owned resources; the district controller releases shared materials.
contract.collision: The furniture plan is shared by geometry and collision. Exterior walls use the coastal navigation grid. Only Bell Pharmacy is enterable in inspection 01.
